items.title: Renew Cape Coral business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Cape Coral Business Tax
items.description: Business tax is paid annually through the city's online portal; Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30. A Lee County receipt is also needed.

items.title: Renew Clearwater business tax receipt
items.description: The business tax year runs October 1 to September 30 and renews annually regardless of when the receipt was obtained; late renewals add delinquent fees.

items.title: Renew Coral Springs business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Coral Springs Business Tax
items.description: Renewal payments are due September 30 each year, including home-based businesses; unpaid tax after 150 days can lead to civil action and a $250 penalty.

note: The town runs a renewal portal and a fee schedule by classification; no due date was found on its pages.

items.title: Renew Fort Lauderdale business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Fort Lauderdale Business Tax
items.description: The renewal period runs July 1 through September 30 and unpaid receipts are delinquent October 1. A separate Broward County receipt is also required.

items.title: Renew Gainesville business tax receipt
items.description: Renewal statements are mailed in late August; payment is due October 1 and penalties accrue after that. State-regulated licenses must be on file.

items.title: Renew Hialeah business tax receipt
items.description: Business tax receipts cover October 1 through September 30; renewals are handled by the Business Tax Division in person, not by mail.

items.title: Renew Hollywood business tax receipt
items.description: Each local business tax receipt expires September 30; renewal happens during September and a receipt not renewed within 30 days after that lapses.

items.title: Renew Jacksonville local business tax receipt
items.description: Businesses operating in Jacksonville (Duval County) need a local business tax receipt; receipts run October 1 to September 30 and unpaid receipts incur a late penalty from October.

items.title: Renew Lakeland business tax receipt
items.description: Every business located or operating inside the city limits pays an annual business tax, based on square footage, workers and category; Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30.

items.title: Obtain and renew City of Miami Business Tax Receipt
items.description: Businesses located in the City of Miami need a city business tax receipt; receipts expire September 30 each year.

items.title: Obtain and renew Miami-Dade County Local Business Tax Receipt
items.description: Businesses within a municipality must hold both the city and the county local business tax receipt; the tax year runs October 1 – September 30.

items.title: Renew Miramar business tax receipt
items.description: Business tax receipts should be renewed on or before September 30 to avoid additional fees; bills are sent by email.

items.title: Renew City of Orlando business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Orlando Permitting Services Division
items.description: All business tax receipts expire September 30. The city sends invoices by July 1 and payment is due by October 1; penalties are 10% in October, rising monthly to 25% in January. Businesses also need an Orange County receipt.

items.title: Renew Palm Bay business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Palm Bay Business Tax
items.description: Renewal opens July 1 and covers the fiscal year October 1 through September 30; renewals are online through the city's portal.

items.title: Renew Pembroke Pines business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pembroke Pines Business Tax
items.description: The local business tax receipt is issued annually and runs October 1 through September 30; invoices and payment are online.

items.title: Renew Pompano Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of Pompano Beach Business Tax
items.description: Business tax receipts expire September 30; if the renewal fee is not paid by October 1 the account is delinquent and penalties apply. A Broward County receipt is separate.

items.title: Renew St. Petersburg business tax receipt
items.authority: City of St. Petersburg Business Tax Division
items.description: Businesses located within St. Petersburg city limits pay an annual business tax and hold a city business tax receipt, issued and collected by the city.

note: Florida law sets September 30 for business tax receipts, but no city or Leon County page was found to confirm local receipts.

items.title: Renew City of Tampa business tax receipt
items.description: Businesses operating in Tampa hold a city business tax receipt for the fiscal year ending September 30, in addition to the Hillsborough County receipt. Florida law makes receipts payable by September 30, with a penalty from October.

items.title: Renew West Palm Beach business tax receipt
items.authority: City of West Palm Beach Business Tax
items.description: The tax runs on an October 1 to September 30 fiscal year; the renewal period is July 1 through September 30 and unpaid taxes are delinquent October 1 with penalties up to 25%.
